error_message: Pi intermittently unreachable on LAN; SSH sessions freeze/drop, worst around each probe sweep cycle
root_cause: eth0 and wlan3 had no connected 192.168.1.0/24 route; the only subnet route belonged to wlan0, whose wt-* connection is torn down and re-added on every probe visit (ip monitor confirms add/delete each visit), so between visits there was no /24 route at all and SSH replies blackholed or detoured via the gateway (ICMP-redirect cache). Contributing: netplan-wlan0-77fast5 autoconnects on ANY wifi radio (no interface-name pin), fighting the tester for wlan0/wlan1/wlan2; wlan3 (standing link) was in tester.interfaces, protected only by an accidental IP-collision skip.
fix: Restored eth0/wlan3 connected routes (ip route replace proto kernel); pinned netplan-wlan0-77fast5 to wlan3 via connection.interface-name; removed wlan3 from tester.interfaces; replaced single-slot extra-radio IP allocator in runner.py preflight with _next_free_cidr() which walks down past LAN-answered or radio-claimed addresses (old code permanently dropped a radio on one collision, and removing wlan3 from the list had shifted wlan4 onto a taken slot).
